records.issue_text: add_members does not strip usernames from params[:usernames].split(","), so "bob, alice" fails to find " alice"
records.rationale: In Admin::GroupsController#add_members, `usernames = params.require(:usernames)` is split via `usernames.split(",")` and each `username` is passed directly to `User.find_by_username(username)` with no `.strip`. This means inputs like "bob, alice" will include a leading space in the second token (" alice"), likely preventing a match and failing to add that user.

records.issue_text: add_members silently skips non-existent users and still returns success, with no error or feedback for partial or total failure
records.rationale: In `Admin::GroupsController#add_members`, usernames are split and each is looked up with `User.find_by_username(username)`. Non-existent users are simply skipped (`if user = ...`) and the action still renders `success_json` as long as `group.save` succeeds, even if zero users were added or only some were added. There is no error/feedback path for partial/total failure shown in the diff.

records.issue_text: GET /admin/groups/:id/users endpoint is removed with no deprecation or alias, a breaking API change for existing consumers
records.rationale: The diff shows the admin group nested route `get "users"` being removed in `config/routes.rb` and replaced with `delete "members"` and `put "members"`. There is no alias/redirect/deprecation path added for the old GET endpoint, so existing consumers of `/admin/groups/:id/users` would break.

records.issue_text: addMembers never clears the usernames input after a successful add (acknowledged TODO), so clicking Add again re-submits the same usernames
records.rationale: In `admin-group.js.es6` the `addMembers` action contains `// TODO: should clear the input` and only calls `this.get("model").addMembers(this.get("usernames"));` without ever resetting `usernames` on success (or at all). This means the input value remains and clicking Add again will re-submit the same usernames.
